messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: n_images in rec.tab from camtrapR::recordTable
parts:
David, 
the column "n_images" is a new feature since version 1.2 (see the news file, my bad for not posting about the new version here in the group yet). It will be created regardless of how you set the function arguments. The idea is to give users the number of images in a particular event, which of course if only relevant when minDeltaTime is not 0.

By the same token, the new arguments "eventSummaryColumn" and "eventSummaryFunction" can be used to calculate statistics over the events (e.g. mean ambient temperature, maximum count of indivuduals etc). This is because in the past (when minDeltaTime is not 0) only the metadata of the first image of an event was reported, the rest omitted despite potentially useful information.

As a general note, data frames with heterogeneous columns can be combined with rbindlist from the data.table package. You need to store all data frames in a list first, then call rbindlist. It works like a charm.

Jürgen
